Method of Attack: Encrypts data by moving files with specific extensions into a password protected RAR archive
Demands ransom of 0.33 bitcoins (~140 USD) to decrypt files
Password is the archive name combined with the logged in username
Monitors and terminates processes with names containing security software or popular sites/games
Deletes SafeBoot registry key to prevent safe mode boot (unsuccessful due to privileges)
Checks blockchain.info for exact ransom payment to decrypt files
Does not communicate with developer except blockchain payment check
Impacted Systems: Systems infected via bundled uTorrent installer
Indicators of Compromise: Password protected RAR archive with 41 character SHA1 hash filename in %AppData% folder
SHA1 hash of processorId + volume_serial_number_of_c + motherboard_serial_number used as archive name
